name: Borderline Farm
tagline: Borderline Farm — Apples in Sturgis, MI
description: Borderline Farm is an on-farm market in 71269 Bauman Rd, MI, selling produce straight from the field. Because everything is sold where it is grown, selection follows the local harvest calendar. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
